name: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Investment of Fixed Capital
benefit:
##### **Standard Projects**

- Eligible entities (Logistics Parks (Multi-modal/Integrated), Inland Container Depots, Container Freight Stations, Air Freight Stations, Warehouses, Cold Chain Units, Testing Facilities, Truck Terminals) are entitled to 10% of fixed capital invested in Fixed Assets.
- **Maximum Amount:** Capped at ₹25,00,000/- per unit per year.
##### **Special Category Projects**

-
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must not be classified as a Mega Project. - The applicant must own a business unit in Goa. - The applicant must provide Logistics and Warehousing services in Goa. - The applicant must be a Logistics and Warehousing services provider, as the categories of business activities listed in Annexure-XI are exhaustive. - The applicant must have a Permanent Account Number (PAN). - The applicant must regularly file Income Tax Returns in the name of the legal entity. - The applicant must be in continuous operations for a minimum period of six months post the date of notification of Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must have incurred the expenses post the date of launch of the Logistics and Warehousing Policy 2023. - The applicant must provide a minimum of 40% local employment. - The applicant must submit claims in the prescribed application form (ANNEXURE-II) through the Goa Online Portal. - The applicant must ensure that the unit was not set up with second-hand machinery. - The applicant must ensure that the value of plant, machinery, and equipment procured has not previously enjoyed any incentives under any earlier incentive schemes. ##### ***Minimum Land Area Requirements (Must be met at time of application/claim)*** - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 1 Acre for Logistics Park, Inland Container Depot, or Container Freight Stations. - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 1,000 square meters for Air Freight Stations, Warehouses, or Truck Terminals. - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 200 square meters for Cold Storage or Testing Facilities. ##### ***Minimum Land Area Requirements (For Special Categories)*** - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 1 Acre for Logistics Park, Inland Container Depot, or Container Freight Stations if constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities. - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 1,000 square meters for Air Freight Stations if constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities. - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 500 square meters for Warehouses or Truck Terminals if constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities. - The applicant must have a minimum land area of 100 square meters for Cold Storage or Testing Facilities if constructed in Backward Talukas OR owned by Women Entrepreneurs/Entrepreneurs belonging to Schedule Caste/Schedule Tribe Communities.
